depth_policy: Rest-depth retained; hidden lateral motion is unobserved.

reference_review.stance_speed_evidence: Clear fore-paw stance runs advance about 10-13 pixels per native 24 fps frame.
reference_review.phase_policy: Reviewed fore touchdown; hind half-cycle pairing regularized across ambiguous overlap. Not claimed as measured hidden-limb motion.
reference_review.curve_policy: Explicit periodic stance and swing paths, reference-guided extrema; keeps full stride instead of reconciling an erroneous last-frame paw track.

foreleg_fold.observation: Foreleg elbow bows backward, while the terminal paw turns down during the lifted swing.
foreleg_fold.correction: The preceding revision incorrectly selected the forward hinge branch. Use the backward branch throughout the cycle and retain the independent airborne paw guide.
foreleg_fold.angles_policy: The negative canonical-depth hinge pole encodes reviewed bend direction; paw angles remain authored pose guides, not measured 3D joint rotations.

shoulder_placement.observation: The prior limb mass emerges too far toward the neck. Rotate the existing scapula offset rearward, retaining native segment lengths and the established sole paths.
shoulder_placement.transfer: Chest-relative orientation preference, independently solved on target; do not copy actor shoulder angles.
shoulder_placement.uncertainty: Shoulder center is occluded by fur. This guide is authored from visible limb attachment and must be checked in deformed renders.
shoulder_placement.deformation_policy: Actor profiles preserve shoulder-owned chest fur/ornament orientation. The upper origin follows a native-length arc expressed as local translation and rotation; bind/rest data and anatomical parent distances remain fixed.

secondary_motion.back: Excess anterior-back motion came from limb-weighted dorsal fur. Corrected torso ownership; accepted body and limb parameters retained.
secondary_motion.tail: Coherent whole-section bend; reduced tip independence. Target-specific centered, reduced-amplitude native-tail adapter.
secondary_motion.tail_observation_policy: Manually reviewed surface endpoint estimates, 960x540 camera. Two-harmonic periodic smoothing reconciles the nonperiodic tail at the gait loop boundary; not 3D capture.

post_processing.method: continuous stance plus exact weighted surface IK
post_processing.loop_policy: periodic trajectories and pose spline; no terminal stride compression

source_contact_validation.slide_measurement: Horizontal velocity of the same evaluated sole vertices after adding actor forward speed; stance cores only.

localized_skin_repair.repair_scope: Prior reviewed neck/collar/back skin repair, followed by explicitly requested tail-only rest straightening and rebinding.

repair_chain.repair_scope: Skin influences only in reviewed dorsal neck; rest geometry, rig and animation curves preserved. Appearance of other clips can improve/change with the repaired skin.

repair_chain.policy: Actor-specific attachment repair; source leg transforms and geometry unchanged; other clips retain curves but their skin deformation can change.

tail_rest_repair.correction_policy: Tail-only XY-plane straightening preserves each segment length and rearward Z offset; bake weighted rest surface, transform normals, rebind six native joints and rebase only tail channels.

attachment_skin_repair.policy: Actor-specific attachment repair; source leg transforms and geometry unchanged; other clips retain curves but their skin deformation can change.

secondary_motion.method: One smooth bend distributed through the lower/end/tip chain; small inherited tip contribution

coherent_tail_intent.source_fit_policy: Reviewed surface endpoint is a soft guide. Fixed section distribution and two periodic harmonics constrain shape coherence.
coherent_tail_intent.user_review_correction: Independent distal fitting improved endpoint error but produced an excessive counter-curl. Whole-section motion takes priority over that score.
